visualCharacteristics.description: Search form on a light-grey band (brand select, ZIP/city input, radius select, optional 'Certified marketers only' checkbox, 'Search >' and 'Use my location' buttons), then a map (only with a Maps key) and a two-column grid of result cards: name, address, '{distance} mi - {City}', phone, website, Directions, badge footer.
visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: none (map with markers when a Google Maps key is configured)

contentPattern.description: Key/value rows (cell 1 key, cell 2 value). Only Type is required; every label and message has a default. The block calls the Chevron locator service via JSONP; ZIP/city search and the map need a google-maps-api-key row in the site configuration sheet (/configuration.json; locally /content/configuration.json). Without a key the block searches from the browser location only and shows a notice. URL params ?zip= ?brand= ?radius= pre-fill and auto-search.

keys.type: distributor | installer | retailer (marketer accepted as alias of distributor)
keys.brands: comma list; default per type (distributor none, installer Havoline, retailer Delo, Havoline, Techron). One brand = preselected; several = required choice
keys.default-radius: distributor 100, installer 40, retailer empty (user must choose)
keys.searched-again-empty-message: distributor/installer retry also empty; same tokens
keys.no-key-notice: shown when no Maps key is configured
keys.badge-certified / badge-elite / badge-fi: Certified Marketer / Chevron 1st Source Elite / Chevron 1st Source / Chevron Preferred

suitableFor: Chevron where-to-buy pages: find a distributor, find an installer, find a retailer (Find nearby)
notSuitableFor: non-US regions or the Caltex/Texaco locators (not implemented)
